Metadata.title: 130 UNICEF Club — School No. 130
Metadata.description: The UNICEF Club of School No. 130 is part of the UNICEF Club Mongolia network: a student club organising volunteer activities in three directions — advocacy, education and fundraising.

Common.emptyDescription: Join the club and do good together.

Footer.about: A student club of School No. 130 and part of the UNICEF Club Mongolia network. Founded in the 2025–2026 school year.
Footer.disclaimer: This is a school student club website, not an official UNICEF website.

Home.heroBody: We are the student club of School No. 130, part of the UNICEF Club Mongolia network. We organise volunteer activities in three directions: advocacy, education and fundraising.

Home.eventsDescription: Join us — helping hands are always needed.

Home.connectBodyNoPartners: We work together with our school community.

Home.ctaBody: Join the club and take part in helping children.
